description: This bar chart illustrates a comparison of runtime performance for different models in a streaming environment. The horizontal axis displays the model names—Our Joint Framework, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, LLaMA, and Claude—presented in the order they appear. The vertical axis, labeled “Runtime (seconds),” represents the runtime values, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, and tick marks at 50-second intervals.  There are five bars representing each model; the “Our Joint Framework” bar is green and measures approximately 77 seconds, while the “ChatGPT” bar is light blue and measures approximately 190 seconds. The “DeepSeek” bar is also light blue and measures approximately 365 seconds, the “LLaMA” bar is light blue and measures approximately 172 seconds, and the “Claude” bar is light blue and measures approximately 243 seconds. All bars are rectangular and not visually emphasized, and the models are not sorted in any apparent order.
